description: Machine-readable research ledger for external repositories and extractable mechanisms. Facts remain source-backed; unknown facts remain PENDING.

mechanisms.name: connection-lifecycle-control
mechanisms.description: Per-connection lifecycle state machine and explicit lifecycle hooks.
mechanisms.load2Mapping: Apply explicit SMTP connection/session lifecycle boundaries without importing HTTP attack states.
mechanisms.notes: Source-backed. Adapt only the lifecycle separation principle.

mechanisms.name: connection-rate-control
mechanisms.description: Separate connection establishment rate from active concurrency, with bounded ramp work.
mechanisms.load2Mapping: Keep SmartPaceController as the single pacing system and MaxConcurrency as the concurrency gate; audit every connection-creating path against both dimensions.
mechanisms.notes: Do not introduce a second load2 pacing system.

mechanisms.name: partial-slow-io
mechanisms.description: Explicit control over partial I/O/read progression.
mechanisms.load2Mapping: Bounded authorized diagnostic scenario capability, isolated from normal SMTP delivery flow.
mechanisms.notes: Requires existing authorization, cancellation, pacing and observability gates.

mechanisms.name: timeout-and-probe-model
mechanisms.description: Independent probe, baseline and explicit timeout/failure detection.
mechanisms.load2Mapping: Strengthen independent health/probe evidence while keeping SMTP delivery outcomes separate from probe state.
mechanisms.notes: Probe timeout is an observed outcome, not silently discarded retry noise.

mechanisms.name: worker-concurrency-model
mechanisms.description: Reactor scheduling, bounded per-pass work and isolated blocking cleanup.
mechanisms.load2Mapping: Apply bounded async scheduling and isolate potentially blocking session cleanup where benchmarks/tests justify it; retain C# async architecture.
mechanisms.notes: Do not port the C++ reactor implementation.

mechanisms.name: scenario-parametrization
mechanisms.description: Central configuration for target, mode, rate, concurrency, timeout, probe and reporting parameters.
mechanisms.load2Mapping: Use a single validated scenario model with explicit defaults/derived values and existing authorization/test gates.

mechanisms.name: measurement-and-reporting
mechanisms.description: Single event log feeding multiple report projections and explicit inconclusive outcomes.
mechanisms.load2Mapping: Align with MailTestResult as source data and RunObservability/RunReport as projections; preserve insufficient-evidence states.
mechanisms.notes: One authoritative run model prevents report disagreement.

mechanisms.name: worker-socket-pool
mechanisms.description: Controller/worker separation with each worker owning connection objects and shared counters.
mechanisms.load2Mapping: Retain load2 bounded worker/channel/session-pool architecture; use GoldenEye only as a separation reference.
mechanisms.notes: Upstream is deprecated; no Python multiprocessing port.

mechanisms.name: http-method-and-header-variation
mechanisms.description: Method selection and variable headers/user agents for scenario diversity.
mechanisms.load2Mapping: Transfer only bounded protocol/payload variation through IMailPayloadPlugin/scenario mechanisms; never bypass pacing, authorization or observability.
mechanisms.notes: Do not import uncontrolled randomization or attack-specific payloads.

mechanisms.name: keepalive-session-reuse
mechanisms.description: Reusable HTTP connection objects with keep-alive requests.
mechanisms.load2Mapping: Reinforces persistent SMTP sessions, explicit lifecycle, synchronization and cancellation.
mechanisms.notes: HTTP-specific headers are not transferred; session reuse principle is.

mechanisms.name: multiprocess-or-worker-scheduling
mechanisms.description: Worker monitoring, bounded joins and stop propagation on interruption.
mechanisms.load2Mapping: Strengthen cancellation propagation and deterministic cleanup tests across workers and SMTP sessions.
mechanisms.notes: Use as shutdown design evidence, not as a multiprocessing requirement.

mechanisms.name: ssl-verification-policy
mechanisms.load2Mapping: Default-safe TLS verification with explicit insecure/test policy and network-layer separation.
